acceptedAnswer.text: A flat, modular platform on legs, most often 4 ft by 8 ft. Decks lock together side by side to make a stage, a riser or a runway at the height you choose.
Around 8 to 16 in for a small audience, around 24 in for seated rows, and 32 in or more when a large standing crowd needs to see over the people in front.
